Proposed solutions

Rule-based decision support from size, density, growth speed and predicted lung function. It does not replace tumor-board review, staging (PET-CT, EBUS, brain MRI) or molecular testing.
Regression and growth parameters are illustrative. Decisions rest with the treating team.
